raw_text:
Install dependencies and build the plugin.

export BRAINTRUST_API_KEY='your-api-key'
export BRAINTRUST_PROJECT='your-project-name'  # traces will be logged here
export BRAINTRUST_DEBUG=true                   # optional: enables debug logging

Config: `.opencode/braintrust.json` (project) or `~/.config/opencode/braintrust.json` (global). Keys: `trace_to_braintrust`/`TRACE_TO_BRAINTRUST` (boolean, `false`); `project`/`BRAINTRUST_PROJECT` (string, `"opencode"`); `debug`/`BRAINTRUST_DEBUG` (boolean, `false`); `api_key`/`BRAINTRUST_API_KEY`; `api_url`/`BRAINTRUST_API_URL` (`"https://api.braintrust.dev"`); `app_url`/`BRAINTRUST_APP_URL` (`"https://www.braintrust.dev"`); `org_name`/`BRAINTRUST_ORG_NAME`.

Precedence: global, project, environment (highest). Environment variables override config file settings. Boolean environment variables accept `true`, `TRUE`, `1` (case-insensitive) as truthy values.

./install.sh && TRACE_TO_BRAINTRUST=true BRAINTRUST_DEBUG=true opencode run -m anthropic/claude-3-haiku-20240307 "say hello and nothing else"
./install.sh && ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=invalid-key TRACE_TO_BRAINST=true BRAINTRUST_DEBUG=true opencode run -m anthropic/claude-3-haiku-20240307 "say hello" 2>&1 || true
grep "session.error"
